answer: Anchor every agent to one FIDO2 hardware security key. Step one, the agent registers its key attestation certificate, a jade-green seal of manufacturer origin, in a public registry. Step two, each epoch the key signs the challenge inside the device, so the secret never leaves the silicon. Step three, a duplicate key ID voids both identities and burns a $40 bond. Forging 10,000 fakes means buying 10,000 keys at $25 each plus $400,000 in bonds and 45 days of registration, against an ocean of honest agents. The key is an onyx anchor: one body, one key, no copies.
